scope: DS ROM fused SU-chain levers (dsrom_recovery_20261004/su_chains/takeover) re-run on the HBM SU's wiring, full shape, cached golden 1M operands (L0/L3/L20/L24/head + stress), 1.2 GHz bench clock (not sign-off)

wiring.mapping: the ROM's 1.2 GHz hub stages are its 0.9 GHz SU stages x 748/504 um (SS wire reach), rounded up: BCAST 22 -> 33, RET 15 -> 23.  The HBM SU (ot_hdc_v41x_vec N1024/M256) has BCAST 4 / RET 5: ceil(4 x 748/504) = 6 in, ceil(5 x 748/504) = 8 out.  RW/BW 9 (lane tree <-> scalar tail, a property of the 1,024-lane unit) unchanged.
wiring.lane_latency: norm and swiglu at the benches' LM5/LA4 (f12 l5 mul / l4 add; the tbs expose no LM/LA parameter, so changing them needs a bench edit); hcpost at M6A5

norm q || norm kv (+RoPE tail + FP8 QDQ): two dedicated units in parallel (q N256 D1280; kv N512 D512 RD64)
